display_name: US Equity Long-Term Value Batch Screening (Buffett Four Filters · beta)
description: Parallel research screening for each US equity using a Buffett-style value-investing framework covering business model, moat & capital allocation, financial quality, and valuation with margin of safety. Research aid only — not investment advice. The Skill does not produce target prices, return forecasts, or buy/sell recommendations. Beta release: combine with local evidence audit and human review.
